# A node the tested component renders exactly once is never null, so
# `c.k != null` is true on every target and needs no presence check of its own.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    vbox {
        button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
    }
}

func testRendered(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.k != null)
    t.assert(!(c.k == null))
    c.k.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
}

window {
    main
}
